text: Concentrate all your thoughts upon the work at hand. The sun's rays do not burn until brought to focus.
Don't cry because it's over. Smile because it happened.
Rather than waste time and energy worrying, use that time and energy to constructively deal with whatever is causing the worry.

You must live in the present, launch yourself on every wave, find your eternity in each moment. Fools stand on their island of opportunities and look toward another land. There is no other land; there is no other life but this.
No need to hurry. No need to sparkle. No need to be anybody but oneself.
Heal the past, live the present, dream the future.
If you need inspiration, don't do it.
If you want something new, you have to stop doing something old.
It's what you do in the present that will redeem the past and thereby change the future.
If you have only one smile in you give it to the people you love.
Thinking is the hardest work there is. That is why so few people engage in it.
If you pray for rain, be prepared to deal with some mud.
One never does wrong by doing right.
This is the most simple and basic component of life: our struggles determine our successes.
It is under the greatest adversity that there exists the greatest potential for doing good, both for oneself and others.
How much pain they have cost us, the evils which have never happened.
Take the attitude of a student. Never be too big to ask questions. Never know too much to learn something new.
If you're walking down the right path and you're willing to keep walking, eventually you'll make progress.
The most important thing in communication is to hear what isn't being said.
Even if you stumble and fall down, it doesn't mean you've chosen the wrong path.
Human behavior flows from three main sources: desire, emotion, and knowledge.
The more something threatens your identity, the more you will avoid it.
Some of us learn from other people's mistakes and the rest of us have to be other people.
Be the reason someone smiles. Be the reason someone feels loved and believes in the goodness in people.
We are all different. Don't judge, understand instead.
Don't let the noise of others opinions drown out your inner voice.
The danger of an adventure is worth a thousand days of ease and comfort.
Catch, then, O catch the transient hour; Improve each moment as it flies!
It still holds true that man is most uniquely human when he turns obstacles into opportunities.
Just get out and do it. You will be very, very glad that you did.
The only way out is through.
All men are equal before fish.
Thinking is difficult, that's why most people judge.
He who can no longer pause to wonder and stand rapt in awe, is as good as dead; his eyes are closed.
If you practiced for the day, then you have won. If you were lazy for the day, then you have lost.
A hut full of laughter is richer than a palace full of sadness.
When one door closes another door opens.
To lose your temper is only useful once a year.
To understand the heart and mind of a person, look not at what he has already achieved, but at what he aspires to.
The price of inaction is far greater than the cost of making a mistake.
Opportunity comes when you continually push forward.
People who avoid failure also avoid success.
Nothing can survive without food. Everything we consume acts either to heal us or to poison us.
Don't stop when you're tired. Stop when you're done.
I am not what happened to me, I am what I choose to become.
Time stays long enough for anyone who will use it.
The greatest deception men suffer is from their own opinions.
Words used to attract the dull of wit are not to be relied on.
My instinct is always to seek out challenges as opposed to avoiding them.
The chief danger in life is that you may take too many precautions.
